conditions.gold: groupby creates groups for consecutive runs of equal keys; it does not aggregate equal keys globally regardless of input order.
To collect all items of each key together, input should be sorted/grouped on the same key function before groupby; groupby does not perform sorting itself.

returned_claim_judgments.text: groupby() groups only consecutive identical keys; it does not sort the data.
groupby is a streaming operation that does not look ahead or back, so only adjacent elements with the same key are grouped together.
To collect all equal keys together, sort by the grouping key first with sorted(data, key=...) before passing to groupby().
The consecutive-only grouping is intentional and efficient, but it means the data must be pre-sorted on the grouping key.
